entries.subject: ESA/Hubble opo0639a (Chandra, Hubble, Magellan composite)
entries.finding: The 2006 composite: X-ray gas in pink, lensing mass map in blue, over a visible-light image; 3000 x 2168 px over 7.45 x 5.38 arcmin, north up, CC BY 4.0. Registered against Gaia DR3.
